details.description: GLM-4.6 is Z.ai's (formerly Zhipu AI) open-weight Mixture-of-Experts language model, released September 30, 2025, offered on Together AI. It has 357 billion parameters, per its Hugging Face model card, and a context window expanded to 200K tokens from GLM-4.5's 128K, per Z.ai's documentation. It supports a thinking mode, tool use during inference, and improved agentic tool invocation, and was evaluated by Z.ai in coding-agent environments including Claude Code, Cline, Roo Code, and Kilo Code. It is released under the MIT license. As of September 2026, four newer Z.ai generations (GLM-4.7, GLM-5, GLM-5.1, and GLM-5.2) have since launched.
advantages: Scores 68.0% on SWE-bench Verified and 82.8 on LiveCodeBench-v6, per Z.ai's GLM-4.7 model card, which reports GLM-4.6's scores as a comparison baseline.
Scores 83.2 on MMLU-Pro and 81.0 on GPQA-Diamond, per Z.ai's GLM-4.7 model card.
Supports a thinking mode alongside tool use during inference, aimed at stronger agentic tool-use and search performance, per Z.ai's documentation.
200K-token context window, expanded from GLM-4.5's 128K, per Z.ai's documentation.
Released under the permissive MIT license.
disadvantages: Superseded as Z.ai's flagship by four newer generations released within the following year: GLM-4.7 (December 2025), GLM-5 (February 2026), GLM-5.1 (April 2026), and GLM-5.2 (June 2026), per Z.ai's release notes.
Text-only model; Z.ai's documentation describes no image or audio input support.
Scores lower than GLM-4.7 on every benchmark Z.ai lists for both models, including SWE-bench Verified (68.0 vs. 73.8) and Terminal Bench 2.0 (24.5 vs. 41.0), per Z.ai's GLM-4.7 model card.
use_cases: AI coding assistance and agent frameworks such as Claude Code, Cline, Roo Code, and Kilo Code
Agentic tool use and search-augmented workflows
Translation, including French, Russian, Japanese, and Korean
Content creation such as scripts, copywriting, and virtual character interactions

sources.title: New Released - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (202752) matches GLM-4.6's max_position_embeddings from its Hugging Face config. Z.ai's docs page actually lists a 128K maximum-output-tokens figure alongside the 200K input context window, which disagrees with the catalog's empty max_output_tokens value; no max_output_tokens claim is made in details, keeping the catalog's empty value per instructions. Benchmark scores are Z.ai's own comparison numbers for GLM-4.6, published on the GLM-4.7 model card, since GLM-4.6's own card shows only a benchmark chart image with no extractable numeric values; confirmed by fetching the GLM-4.7 page directly. No deprecation date is set in the catalog facts. This is the same underlying model already covered under sibling slugs for other hosts (e.g. Fireworks AI); this entry researches the Together AI-listed URI independently per the instructions.
